author: DrSwing
text:
Hi scoobydo, I am delighted you have found my journal of use on you own journey to trading enlightenment.

I am currently honing my TT skills, as I want to trade If-like!

. I will TT my level if I

can secure a tight stoploss, other wise I wait for PA as this can give a small sl with conformation.

My advice to anyone new would be to trade PA until you have mastered that method. All my levels are found on the far left of the chart. To be confident in your levels you need to dig into the charts to prove to yourself what levels work. Aaron has been an inspirational example of posting his work on the forum. It takes alot of back testing and chart digging down to M1 level. Confidence in your levels will come down to your own chart work. Nothing anyone can tell you will take the place of your own chart study. If you need an answer to a question that can be found by chart study, then dig in and find it for yourself, as it is the best learning. Your own chart study will bring you many aha! monents.

All this advice is from my own experience. Enjoy the journey

author: Oedipus
text:
DrSwing wrote: Well guys and gals it's time for me to fess up!

I'll be a year here on RTM next week, and for months now I can smell and even touch the other side, but I just cant break through. Right now I find I am spinning my wheels, basically going around in circles, in frustration. So very often I have felt so close to being at one with the markets, only to awake the following day a stranger again. I am not learning anything new and not having any new aha moments, and this week in particular I just seem to have a mental block. Sure I can read the past PA all day and all night, but I just can't trade the hard right edge! Not even on Forextester!

When I first joined I posted quite a lot, but then I found that the more I learned the more difficult it became to post. You see, I wanted to be able to help lead the way, but I found that my posting was often inaccurate and therefore misleading to members. So I would only post the things that I was definite about. This made it very difficult for me to make comments on posts or attempt to answer members questions. So I worked harder in silence, digging into the charts in order to be able to make posts that would add value to the forum.

Now heading into my second year, I feel something needs to change. My plan is to start posting regularly again with you all clearly knowing that I am just a mickey mouse trader who is still learning. Even if my posts don't help anyone maybe it will at least help shift my own mental block. Maybe I need the forum now more than it needs me. So please be aware that I am further from being a master trader than most of you posting here, and that everything I post is just my own probably misguided understanding.

Thank you If for your continued support and your patience with our silence.

God Bless all drswing

It was reading this that made me come back and try again. I have felt EXACTLY the same way many times. Watching your progression from where you were to where you are now is an inspiration. Thanks Doc.
